# Plot an igraph network on a leaflet map

Draws each vertex as a clustered marker at its coordinates and each edge
as a grey line between the vertices it connects.

## Usage

``` r
plot_leaflet(g, lat, lon, col = "site", label = "none", tile = "Default")
```

## Arguments

- g:

  An igraph object.

- lat:

  Name of the vertex attribute holding latitude.

- lon:

  Name of the vertex attribute holding longitude.

- col:

  Name of the vertex attribute used to colour markers, or `"none"` to
  draw every marker in black. Colours are recycled if there are more
  than 19 groups.

- label:

  Name(s) of the vertex attribute(s) shown in marker labels, each on its
  own line as `attribute: value`, or `"none"` to label markers with the
  vertex name.

- tile:

  Background tiles: `"Default"` (OpenStreetMap), `"Terrain"` (Stadia
  Stamen Terrain), or any other value for Stadia Stamen Terrain
  Background.

## Value

A leaflet htmlwidget.

## Examples

``` r
plot_leaflet(example_network, "lat", "long", col = "site")
```
